minor.issue: Both callers passed keyword `from_account=...` but SendGridEmailService.send_email() signature uses `from_agent=...`. This raised `TypeError: got an unexpected keyword argument 'from_account'` in the try/except, silently swallowing the delivery-status email AND preventing the outgoing_emails DB record from being inserted (the insert line came AFTER the send call). Fixed both call sites to use `from_agent=`. Verified: outgoing_emails record with tag 'delivery_status_ai' is now inserted (status=failed only because SendGrid quota / auth in preview env, but record is written as spec requires).

ui_bugs.issue: PAGE CRASHES with 'Something went wrong — Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toLowerCase)'. Root cause: lines 174-182 assume nested shape `ticket.ticket_id`, `ticket.customer_details.name`, `ticket.customer_details.email`, `ticket.product_details.brand` but backend GET /api/service-tickets/ actually returns FLAT fields: `ticket_number`, `customer_name`, `customer_email`, `brand`. All 3 current tickets in DB have `ticket_id === undefined` so `.toLowerCase()` throws inside .filter() and ChunkErrorBoundary shows the fallback. Fix: change filter to use the flat schema (or add `|| ''` guards).

rca_of_the_issue:
1) DELIVERY EMAIL SILENT FAILURE — neural_ai_agents.py passed `from_account='service'` to sendgrid_email_service.send_email() which expects `from_agent`. Python raised TypeError before the DB audit record was inserted, so outgoing_emails stayed empty and the review-request's assertion 'record with tag delivery_status_ai gets inserted' failed. Reproduction: send POST /api/neural-ai/chat {agent_type:'delivery', message:'phone 9844577440, email rohit.gadiya@gmail.com'} and grep backend logs for 'Delivery status email failed: ...got an unexpected keyword argument from_account'. Mitigation: renamed kwarg at both call sites. Also recommended (not done): decouple audit-insert from send call so audit survives send failures.

2) SERVICE TICKETS PAGE CRASH — ServiceTicketManagement.js filter block accesses ticket.ticket_id.toLowerCase() etc, but backend GET /api/service-tickets/ returns records with keys {ticket_number, customer_name, customer_email, brand, product_name} — no ticket_id, no customer_details.*, no product_details.*. All 3 tickets in DB therefore blow up the filter on any render (searchTerm defaults to ''). ChunkErrorBoundary catches it → 'Something went wrong'. Reproduction: log in as admin, go to /admin/service-tickets → immediate crash. Not fixed by me — flagged for main agent to refactor whole component.
